title: Profile mode in midis2jam2: K525 through the router
intro: midis2jam2 now sings Delay Lama channels in profile mode by default: each channel gets the imitation profile of its program, high parts fold down by octaves (D37), and every note carries its length. These are the router's own renders of K525's first 30 s with violin 1 sung.

tests.title: K525 violin 1, live mix
tests.question: Which profile should K525's violin 1 get, and does the balance hold?
tests.notes: Clips 2-4 are the live mix at real levels (the band 6 dB down); the monks of all three measure within 0.5 dB. Clip 5 is round 4's pick for comparison (made another way, loudness-matched).
